question_text: A structure consisting of straight wire sections of $AO$, $OB$, $CO$ and $OD$ of equal length arranged so that they are perpendicular to each other at $O$ is shown. When this structure is placed perpendicular to a magnetic field as shown in the figure, due to the field it will experience

options.option_text: a resultant force along the plane of the paper in the downward direction
a resultant force along the plane of the paper in the upward direction
a resultant force along the plane of the paper to the right
a resultant force along the plane of the paper to the left
